newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Koor plans $200 mln Yankee bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Koor plans $200 mln Yankee bond issue.

text.p: Koor Industries board of directors has approved a $200 million Yankee bond offering, the company said in an announcement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Thursday.
"We expect it will be in the first half of this year," a Koor spokesman said.
The offering will be the first ever for Israel's largest holding company and will be used to finance expanded operations under Koor's new strategic plan.
On Wednesday Koor's board approved a four-year strategic plan aimed at raising revenues by the year 2000 to five billion dollars, half deriving from international and export sales by 2000.
The company has already begun talks with potential underwriters.
On Wednesday, Koor reported an 8.4 percent increase in net profit for 1996 to $180.8 million. Koor said exports accounted for 35 percent of its $3.53 billion in revenues.
